scientific_meaning: The 606-drive refresh reproduces the 578-drive control exactly on all displayed cells. 8 of 776 interval-bearing cells (about 1 %) move outside their previous day interval, below the about 5 % expected from nested resampling, and every move is in the direction of the new drives. No supported cell loses support and S* moves by at most 0.0020.

The new drives alone cannot give an interval for the 8 cells (fewer than 5 days), so they can neither confirm nor rule out a real shift.
The shoulder-fast standardized views appear for the first time. They have no earlier version to compare with, and the strata are not comparable.
